choice.description: Apply all stated timing, unit, inclusion, correction, and threshold rules; select the exact band.

contexts: {"event": "Classify final cumulative use relative to the allowance.", "rules": "A usage plan includes 2.40 tebibytes (TiB) of binary transfer per billing cycle. Count 1 TiB as exactly 1,099,511,627,776 bytes. Usage records are decimal gigabytes, where 1 GB is exactly 1,000,000,000 bytes. The account used 875.50 GB, then 1,120.25 GB, then received a correction removing 14.75 GB, then used 670.00 GB. The limit is exceeded only when cumulative bytes are strictly greater than the allowance; equality is not an exceedance."}
